_purpose: Contract file. ChatGPT fills this shape from Reddit/forum climbing posts and saves it as failure_modes.json next to index.html. The app loads it automatically if present.
_instructions_for_collector: Source: r/climbharder, r/bouldering, r/climbing, Mountain Project forums.
Look for posts where someone describes failing a specific move AND attributes a cause.
Do NOT summarise away the attribution detail — the causal claim is the whole point.
lag_in_moves is the key field: how many moves BEFORE the visible failure the writer thinks the real error happened. 0 means the cause was the failing move itself.
verified = true only if the writer says the correction actually worked afterwards.
Target 100-150 records. Partial is fine; the app degrades gracefully.

modes.name: example — delete this entry
modes.move_type: deadpoint | dyno | lock-off | heel hook | smear | mantle | crimp pull | ...
modes.failure_surfaced_as: what visibly went wrong (barn door, foot popped, missed the catch)
modes.attributed_cause: what the writer says actually caused it, in their words
